reviewer: Independent AI synthetic user reviewer, first structured 10K scenario
scope: All frozen old/new weeks plus actual new-domain return simulation; no human/browser/store lifecycle claims. Raw version identity was visible; not a blinded review.
verdict: New materially improves novice entry, LR anchoring and honest assessment. Conditional preference for new; late-cycle specificity and Sunday/Monday volume concentration require review.

findings.expected: The first long run should respect the reported repeatable 8 km long run and develop it gradually.
findings.actual: W1 Sunday is 9.7 km: +21.25% above reported recent LR; 36.2% of its 26.8 km week. New starts at 8 km.

findings.expected: Separate current-fitness reference from hoped-for adaptation; do not assert unmeasured fitness gain.
findings.actual: VDOT rises from 38.3 to 41.8 and predictedSec=2890 (48:10) despite only a 25:00 5K being supplied. New keeps 38.3 and current reference 3113 s (51:53), with 50:00 explicitly a goal.

findings.expected: Late-cycle race-pace work should have a clear 10K endurance purpose; if only small doses are supported, preserve a purposeful recovery or describe it as rhythm familiarization.
findings.actual: W13 2×1000 m @5:11/km with 233 s walking (10.37 min total work); W14 2×1200 m with 240 s walking (12.44 min work). Recovery is ~75%/~64% of one repetition; old used 3 reps with 60 s recovery. New dose is conservative but the combination of small total work and long walking weakens sustained 10K specificity.

findings.expected: For a runner entering the first structured cycle, preserve an easy recovery load after the longest run as weekly volume rises.
findings.actual: W13 Sunday LR 15.3 km is followed by W14 Monday easy 12.2 km plus 6×20 s strides. Consecutive-day distance 27.5 km, ~63% of W14 43.8 km; previous baseline old is 12.7+6.6=19.3 km. New peak LR16.2 is ~105 min at6:28/km. No adjacency between Wed/Fri quality, but the Sunday/Monday load concentrates too much novice volume for an unqualified recommendation.

findings.expected: Deload focus should describe the delivered easy sessions.
findings.actual: Both focus labels say “DELOAD — obim dole, ostaje kratka oštrina” while both weeks have zero sessions/finish work. Strides remain on Monday, so generic sharpness can refer to strides, but there is no dedicated short quality workout.

findings.expected: Recompute focus after removing quality; the return preview should accurately identify easy weeks.
findings.actual: After confirmed return, W8 is titled Fartlek but has zero sessions, strides or finishes; W10 says short sharpness remains but has zero such work. All underlying sessions, km, descriptions, pred and QS remain coherent.

limitations: Synthetic actual history, not evidence from an athlete.
A domain probe does not verify UI preview/apply/cancel/reload; U06 owns browser flow.
Physiological concerns are qualitative judgments without athlete-specific tolerance data.
Existing past skipped sessions are intentionally retained; their presence in historical weeks is not a reintroduced future quality session.
